opencv.core.fixed_matrices.column_index.source_declaration:
--  Zero-based column index, from 0 through Column_Count - 1.
   subtype Column_Index is Natural range 0 .. Column_Count - 1;

opencv.core.fixed_matrices.matrix.source_declaration:
--  Matrix of Row_Count rows and Column_Count columns. Element (Row,
   --  Column) is addressed with zero-based indices in the ranges Row_Index
   --  and Column_Index. Row_Index'Range and Column_Index'Range are the
   --  array bounds.
   type Matrix is array (Row_Index, Column_Index) of Element_Type;

opencv.core.fixed_matrices.row_index.source_declaration:
--  Zero-based row index, from 0 through Row_Count - 1.
   subtype Row_Index is Natural range 0 .. Row_Count - 1;

opencv.core.float16_value.source_declaration:
--  Exact IEEE-754 binary16 encoding used by OpenCV CV_16F. This is
   --  the stored 16-bit pattern, not Short_Float, Float, Integer_16, or
   --  a numeric Unsigned_16 value. Classification inspects the binary16
   --  fields directly: bit 15 is the sign, bits 14 .. 10 are the
   --  exponent, and bits 9 .. 0 are the fraction. Is_Negative reports
   --  the stored sign bit, so it is True for -0, negative finites,
   --  -Infinity, and negative NaNs. NaN payloads, signed zeros,
   --  infinities, and subnormals retain their exact bits.
   --  Float16_From_Bits / Float16_Bits copy that encoding. To_Float16 /
   --  To_Float32 convert numerically between binary16 and binary32.
   --  OpenCV.Core.Float16_Access stores and loads the exact encoding.
   type Float16_Value is private;

opencv.core.vectors.component_index.source_declaration:
--  Zero-based component index, from 0 through Length - 1.
   subtype Component_Index is Natural range 0 .. Length - 1;

opencv.core.vectors.vector.source_declaration:
--  Vector of Length components, indexed from zero through Length - 1.
   type Vector is array (Component_Index) of Element_Type;

opencv.float32_value.source_declaration:
--  IEEE binary32 element value (CV_32F).
   subtype Float32_Value is Interfaces.IEEE_Float_32;

opencv.float64_value.source_declaration:
--  IEEE binary64 element value (CV_64F).
   subtype Float64_Value is Interfaces.IEEE_Float_64;

opencv.int16_value.source_declaration:
--  Signed 16-bit element value (CV_16S).
   subtype Int16_Value is Interfaces.Integer_16;

opencv.int32_value.source_declaration:
--  Signed 32-bit element value (CV_32S).
   subtype Int32_Value is Interfaces.Integer_32;

opencv.int8_value.source_declaration:
--  Signed 8-bit element value (CV_8S).
   subtype Int8_Value is Interfaces.Integer_8;

opencv.uint16_value.source_declaration:
--  Unsigned 16-bit element value (CV_16U).
   subtype UInt16_Value is Interfaces.Unsigned_16;

opencv.uint8_value.source_declaration:
--  Shared public value types owned by the root OpenCV package and
   --  distributed by the opencv_core crate. OpenCV.Core owns Mat and
   --  matrix-specific abstractions; other module crates reuse these
   --  values without redeclaring them.

   --  CV_8U, CV_8S, CV_16U, CV_16S, CV_32S, CV_32F, and CV_64F element
   --  value domains used by typed Mat accessors and shared numeric
   --  APIs. Float16 remains Core-specific.
   --
   --  Unsigned 8-bit element value (CV_8U).
   subtype UInt8_Value is Interfaces.Unsigned_8;
